items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: But we had one in Sharky's band, Jackie Blaine.

ctx.x: We didn't have a girl singer? No.
No. But we had one in Sharky's band, Jackie Blaine. And what became of her, I do not know.
She's almost forgotten. I don't think she made many records.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Yeah, Jackie Blaine. I wish I knew what became of her. I'd love to see her.

ctx.x: Kid Ory. All Neighbors and so-and-so-and-so-and-so-and-so. Bob Hannan. This was a fine puppet show. Oh, man, you just almost knew that they were alive, this act. Never forget them. Cute as they could be. This is at the famous door, of course. Well, they got everybody's picture. Yeah, Jackie Blaine. I wish I knew what became of her. I'd love to see her. Happy birthday. This was by some artist in Jerusalem. Oh.
It says Matthe. M-A-T-H-E. Matthe. Vagabond artist. M-A-T-H-E. Accent of U on the E.
